reason: The variance is real: WAGR-44 is stale (last updated Sep 14, 0 comments, no issue links) and does not record the Sep 1 TAC definition or the Sep 25 decision to keep commissions outside Salesforce. But Jira partly covers it. WAGR-467 says 'Related: WAGR-44' and records the Sep 25 decision, and WAGR-468 records the commission reporting asks. WAGR-44's custom Status is 'On Hold' and its Size is XS. The Sep 1 TAC formula also does not fully remove the block, because the commission matrix is still owed (WAGR-467 says this).
q1: Found, with minor differences. L2317 is at line 564 of the fetched Sep 1 doc (Weekly Sync 2026/09/01). The quote leaves out the words 'So that amount is critical for figuring out our um profit and loss...' and 'Does that make sense?' before Kobi's 'Yeah, that's 100% doable.' The words that are quoted are verbatim. L3095 is in the Sep 25 doc: Kobi's question is at line 248 (00:08:39). Emily's 'integration with um Jay's tool' line and Lina's lines are in the 00:10:17 block, and the quote leaves out Lina's line 'think we can handle it internally just because like the this November 1 date is a pretty hard date.' The wording is verbatim, but the quote joins non-adjacent lines. L3141 is at lines 876-894 (00:58:10-00:59:41). The quote leaves out Joyce's 'Yeah, I'm aligned for sure' and several lines in between, and the wording is verbatim.
q2: Mostly supported, with nuance. On Sep 1, Lina defined TAC as deposit plus commission, needed for P&L reporting. Kobi agreed and offered BA and manager commission amount fields on the Sign-Up with an override, with matrix autofill later, after Lina sends the matrix. On Sep 25, Emily, Lina and Joyce agreed that BA commission calculation (all pay streams) stays in Jay's tool for launch, with Salesforce supplying the data. Kobi then said twice 'we're not doing commissions right now' (lines 894 and 1095). So in-Salesforce Commission Cost auto-calc conflicts with the later decision. Nuance: the Sep 25 question was about calculating the pay streams. It did not explicitly cancel a stored per-sign-up commission amount field. The Sep 1 TAC formula only gives the top-level sum, and the commission matrix input is still owed. The claim that Lina's formulas are no longer the blocker is therefore partly overstated.
q3: No later reversal. I searched the ledger after 2026-09-25 (rows dated Sep 28, 29 and 30) for commission, acquisition, cost, P&L, profit, Jay, Rippling and export, and none came back. Rows on the same day support the claim: L3141, L3154 (threshold logic not built, because commissions are not in this phase), L3164 (calculation automation deferred) and L3096 (the Jay tool mechanism is not defined).
q4: Partly covered. WAGR-44 is live: Open, Unassigned, Phase 1, custom Status 'On Hold', Size XS, Epic 'SLC & Sign-Up Intake', updated 2026-09-14, 0 comments, no issuelinks. Its description still says it is blocked on Lina's formulas and plans Commission Cost and TAC fields. WAGR-467 (Open, Kobi, created Sep 25) says 'Related: WAGR-44' and records that BA commissions stay outside Salesforce at launch, and that Lina still owes the matrix. WAGR-468 (Open, Kobi) records the commission owed reporting asks and the BI-first rule. Neither one records the TAC definition or re-scopes WAGR-44. The JQL search project = WAGR AND (text ~ 'acquisition cost' OR text ~ 'commission') returned WAGR-98, 106, 465, 468, 467, 434, 303, 14, 7 and 44. Only WAGR-44 mentions TAC.
corrections: L3095: Emily's 'integration with Jay's tool' and Lina's agreement are at 00:10:17 (about lines 262-268), not at 00:08:39. Only Kobi's question is at 00:08:39 (line 248). The quote joins non-adjacent lines and leaves out Lina's 'November 1 date is a pretty hard date' line.
